description: Plant-part free-amino-acid observations in perennial ryegrass from the publisher abstract; reference only.
limitations: Cultivated ryegrass plant parts, not GreenHub roadside whole grass; no plant-part mix, variance, or matched sample. No runtime activation.

description: Nitrogenous-fraction measurements for perennial ryegrass under four N rates, transcribed from Pacheco and Waghorn (2008) Table 3; reference only.
limitations: Secondary table transcription; fractions are percentages of total N and do not sum to 100%; no GreenHub roadside transfer or runtime activation.

description: English row-preserving extract of 18 VARTA fibre and whole-grass nutrient laboratory samples.
limitations: Only the GreenHub whole-grass row 7 dry matter and chloride result are connected to the shared UI/backend feed profile; the other 17 samples remain source references. Sample-specific, not a seasonal mean. Other composition fields remain separately sourced or unresolved. No external reuse license identified.

description: English row-preserving extract of 3 VARTA grass-juice nutrient laboratory samples.
limitations: No shared batch identifier links these juice rows to the whole-grass samples; GreenHub juice sample date and matched press masses are missing. No external reuse license identified.

description: Translation and activation crosswalk for the source workbook and two English extracts.
limitations: Source labels and source workbook are retained; profile activation does not establish a paired press mass or nutrient balance.

description: Qualitative site screening and local-use guidance (green/orange/red classes, CROW visual litter quality and examples of visible/invisible contaminants); not a numeric process specification.
limitations: No measured contaminant prevalence, chemical limits, mass fractions, cleaning efficiency, or route-specific acceptance criteria. Location decisions remain case-specific.

description: Two first-party Greenhub Zuid-Holland annual processing-capacity ambition statements, preserving roadside-only and mixed-residual scopes separately.
limitations: The 30,000 t/year statements are ambitions, not operating data. The homepage states roadside cuttings; the approach page defines a mixed feed including horticultural residues. Do not treat as contracted supply, installed capacity, achieved throughput, or add the two statements.

description: South Holland provincial maintenance-parcel areas, reported and estimated quantities, and the report's separate literature-yield comparison.
limitations: Annual contractor tonnage basis and underlying measurement year are unstated; South quantity is estimated; North tonnage is not inferred; theoretical potentials are source-calculated and are not collected or GreenHub-accessible supply; possible ditch debris is noted.

description: Treatment-level 2023 Finnish timothy harvest and laboratory press-liquid yields and composition from two cuts and nitrogen treatments.
limitations: Cultivated timothy comparator; plot yields are not delivered roadside supply; lab twin-screw results do not validate GreenHub equipment; raw replicates and complete balances are unavailable; reuse license not identified.

description: Official municipal verge area by mowing regime and separate seasonal mowing-window guidance from Nuenen and Lansingerland.
limitations: Different municipal comparators; area does not equal harvestable or delivered biomass; calendar windows are management guidance, not a measured seasonal mass profile; explicit reuse licenses not identified.

description: Project-reported Greenhub Zuid-Holland collection, handling, process-chain, planned data-collection, and product-use observations; includes one secondary annual-collection claim.
limitations: First-party narrative and one secondary trade-press claim, not underlying weighbridge/lab/process records; 117 t basis, 120 t timeframe, >150 t/year basis/period, and 100 t Bokashi use period/basis are unspecified; the 2026 AquaMinerals announcement is a plan with no published results; figures are not reconciled/summed; no process balances, nutrient assays, or quantitative recoveries.

description: Dutch roadside plot-level initial biomass/composition and fitted dry-matter/N/P/K remaining-fraction parameters for fresh cuttings left in field conditions.
integration_readiness: source-traceable; reference_only; not a storage default
limitations: One 1993 field study; fitted values are not raw time series; fit quality varies; field lying interval must not be conflated with silage storage; article reuse license subtype not confirmed.

description: Measured roadside-grass harvest results and 2018 vehicle operating observations from two Lincolnshire campaigns.
limitations: Aggregate campaign results with no reported uncertainty; wetness categories are qualitative; not Dutch supply. Keep distinct from modeled regional supply scenarios.

description: Seasonal theoretical and technical fresh-mass harvest-potential estimates for five verge-grass management contexts in Flanders and Zeeland.
limitations: Project estimates rather than site measurements; technical values embed a 70% harvestability assumption; no moisture conversion, no explicit source reuse license identified.

description: Mapped 2018 Zeeland road-verge area and source-modeled seasonal supply under two-cut, one-cut, and historical as-is collection scenarios.
limitations: Distinguishes secondary manager inventories, mapped acreage, modeled supply, historical 1% collection, 70% accessibility and 33% DM assumptions; no current GreenHub supply claim.

description: Formic-acid dose labels, bottle-scale additions and brown-liquid precipitation pH from a Finnish pilot timothy-grass study.
integration_readiness: source-traceable; reference_only; blocked from parameter activation
limitations: Published L/Mg labels conflict tenfold with bottle-scale method amounts; no DOI or explicit license identified. Do not use for reagent demand or TEA until dose discrepancy and reuse rights are resolved.

description: Verbatim table means for dry matter, ash, crude protein and true-protein responses across five formic-acid treatments; raw source basis is flagged unresolved.
limitations: Printed response denominator conflicts with the reported sediment mass/component hierarchy; acid dose labels also conflict with bottle additions; no DOI or explicit license identified.

description: Measured pre-mowing standing biomass across ten Dutch road verges, two 2023 sampling rounds and six assigned mowing regimes; source values in g DM/m2.
integration_readiness: source-traceable; reference_only; not a delivered-feed or harvest-yield default
limitations: One source biomass value missing; first block only; two sampling rounds; no commercial access or harvestability data. See sidecar for source/version DOI, license, units, and restrictions.

description: Reported group-level litter and heavy-metal threshold findings from an approximately 75-lot Flemish roadside/nature clipping laboratory survey; summary only, not raw sample measurements.
limitations: Belgian survey; approximate group counts; no item-level numerical concentrations; reuse license not identified; Keurcompost threshold is not a GreenHub acceptance specification.

description: Year-specific 2013/2014 Kassel urban roadside-grass yield means and SDs plus source-reported ensiling, mashing, pressing, methane and gross-energy observations.
limitations: German urban-verge comparator; no GreenHub supply or complete process balance; source and later related press-fluid methane values are not pooled.

description: Seasonal composition of fresh and ensiled road-verge grass from a primary experimental study; values are reference evidence only.
limitations: Sampled in 2019 in Białystok (Poland); FAME data are not crude-lipid measurements; not Dutch GreenHub feedstock; censored sodium observations remain blank.

description: Fresh and four-month-ensiled Lincolnshire road-verge grass proximate and ultimate analyses with source-calculated theoretical methane potential.
limitations: UK roadside comparator; calculated Buswell and Boyle methane potentials assume complete biodegradation; not measured BMP or GreenHub feed.

description: Modeled regional road-verge supply scenarios for Lincolnshire under alternative accessible-radius and swath-width assumptions.
limitations: Study-region scenarios contain assumptions and are not Dutch or GreenHub contracted supply; yields and access assumptions remain scenario-specific.

description: Dutch official and regional roadside-grass mowing, collection and availability observations with separate reported scopes.
limitations: Regional quantities have unresolved mass basis and collection constraints; mixed green waste and uncollected biomass are not GreenHub feed supply.

description: Aggregate annual dry-matter yield means under repeated mulching, four-cut harvest and two-cut harvest management regimes.
limitations: Kassel urban-roadside comparator; no uncertainty or site-level measurements in the abstract extract; not Dutch feedstock availability.

description: Source-located FR0 fresh-perennial-ryegrass composition means and standard deviations from Della Rosa et al. (2022), Table 1; literature comparator only.
integration_readiness: source-traceable; reference_only; not a GreenHub default
limitations: Cultivated New Zealand ryegrass, not roadside/VARTA feed. Means and SD retained; composition-table n is not stated. Derived NFC and pdNDF and the printed crude-fat method-code caveat are explicit.

description: Source-located fresh roadside-grass proximate/ultimate and seasonal metal-screen table summaries from Czubaszek et al. (2023), Tables 3–4.
limitations: Only the five detected summer Table 4 Cr/Ni/Cd/Hg/Pb means are summed and scaled with VARTA dry matter in the GreenHub profile; all other rows remain reference-only. Polish comparator, analytical triplicates are not field replicates, non-detects are censored, and no compliance inference is supported.

description: Seasonal fresh roadside-grass crude-fiber, lignin, hemicellulose, and cellulose observations from Czubaszek et al. (2023), Table 5.
limitations: Białystok, Poland roadside/median grass comparator; means and SDs are analytical triplicates, not field-site replicates. Hemicellulose and cellulose are assay-derived differences. These measurements are not GreenHub defaults, cannot be added to crude fiber, and do not close the UI feed composition.

description: Source-located ranges for Italian ryegrass mono-/disaccharides, fructosan, and total nonstructural carbohydrates; class-B source observations, with four component ranges used only as allocation weights in the tested class-C GreenHub sugar split.
limitations: The source ranges are not point means or GreenHub measurements. The default C-class split normalizes reported range midpoints within the separate Smit roadside-grass aggregate; growth stage, species mix, and sample basis differ. Source reuse license is not identified.

description: Source-located Table 2 NIRS calibration/validation summaries for cultivated perennial ryegrass; starch mean/range used only as a class-C GreenHub profile proxy.
limitations: The source reports a 34 g/kg DM mean across n=100, range 1–169, R²=0.77, SEC=1.45, and SEV=2.23. This is cultivated ryegrass, not roadside/VARTA grass; transfer uncertainty is unquantified. The range is not a probability distribution. Individual measurements are not supplied.

description: Three-year perennial-ryegrass WSC, crude-protein, and WSC-to-CP marginal means by cultivar, nitrogen rate, harvest time, and cut from Olszewska (2021), Tables 2–4.
limitations: Cultivated north-eastern Polish ryegrass, not GreenHub roadside grass. Tables report marginal factor means without SD/SE or the complete joint treatment matrix. WSC is aggregate; crude protein does not identify extraction fractions. No default or runtime activation.

description: Compatibility copy of the 2023 Dutch roadside standing-biomass observations; canonical versioned source extract is road_verge_standing_biomass_bakker_2026_zenodo_reference.csv.
integration_readiness: source-traceable; reference_only; compatibility copy; no runtime mapping
limitations: One source value is missing. Values are standing biomass snapshots in g DM/m2, not harvested or delivered feed. Preserve against the linked Zenodo version DOI; do not use as annual supply.

description: Derived descriptive statistics for the Bakker et al. (2026) standing-biomass observations by mowing treatment and sampling month.
integration_readiness: staged_evidence; descriptive derivation; no runtime parameter mapping
limitations: Means, sample SD, minimum and maximum summarize the source plots only. Do not sum sampling periods or interpret standing biomass as harvested yield.

description: Derived site-level standing-biomass productivity values for ten Dutch roadside grasslands in 2023.
integration_readiness: staged_evidence; descriptive derivation; no runtime parameter mapping
limitations: Values are source standing-biomass context, not accessible, harvestable, collected or contracted supply; not a mass-flow parameter.

description: Local bibliographic and dataset provenance register for staged Phase 1–7 evidence; includes metadata leads only; no product raster payload is staged for the CLMS entries.
limitations: Some sources have no DOI or reuse license. Keep article and dataset identifiers distinct; two pre-existing Zuid-Holland citation duplicates are retained.

description: Table 3 transcription of elemental composition and selected metals for German urban roadside grass under two-cut and four-cut management.
limitations: Kassel urban-roadside comparator, not Dutch supply or GreenHub feedstock. Values are management means without site-level observations or weighting data; below-detection metals remain censored, and analyte denominator is not fully explicit.

description: Table 2 transcription of elemental composition and heating values for German urban roadside-grass press cake under two-cut and four-cut management.
limitations: Kassel press cake is a process-specific comparator, not GreenHub product specification. Second-cut sampling was non-random; heating values are source-calculated; no saleability or GreenHub default is established.

description: Four regional seasonal and ensiled-grass juice statements from the ReJuice WP5 2025 draft; reference-only, not a GreenHub monthly supply curve or press calibration.
limitations: No monthly tonnage shares; approx. 40% juice lacks feed/press denominator, conditions and mass balance; all records remain reference-only.

description: Six first-party ReJuice pilot-plan and monitoring records for grass-juice AD and digestate; no performance measurements.
limitations: Pilot commissioning and actual operation are not verified; 3000–9000 t/year is an expected juice flow, not measured grass supply.

description: Official South Holland annual verge-grass quantity, road-network context and mowing/collection schedule statements.
limitations: Official narrative, not weighbridge or GIS harvest records; annual mass basis and accepted/accessibly collected share unknown; schedules are not measured seasonal tonnage profiles.

description: Single first-party announcement of approximately 600 t roadside-grass processing for an autumn campaign; plan only, not verified realized tonnage.
limitations: No delivered-mass records or wet/dry basis; date is event-context only; a separate same-number GKB-own-grass Bokashi quantity is not confirmation.

description: Nielsen et al. (2021) per-harvest Table 3/4 yields for biomass and screw-pressed streams
limitations: Cultivated Danish fen grasses and lab-scale fractionation; source caption units retained verbatim; no GreenHub transfer or runtime activation.

description: Flemish roadside-grass area and annual dry-matter estimate by managing actor; Table 27 extract
limitations: Mixed historical years and methods; not Dutch site-specific or delivered supply; no runtime activation.

description: Schaffers et al. (1998) Table 4 community field-decay summaries and Table 5 composition regressions
limitations: Fitted/model-derived field-delay values, not raw replicates or storage kinetics; Dutch 1993 roadside plots; no GreenHub activation.

description: 50 official CBS-derived municipal mixed-green-waste values from the Zuid-Holland WFS, reference year 2022; not grass-only and not feedstock availability.
limitations: Mixed municipal green waste; not grass-specific or accessible GreenHub supply. Catalog aggregate discrepancy retained. Primary key: record_id.

description: Table 2 hypothetical collection-point roadside-grass quantities for East Flanders, transcribed as location-level reference estimates.
limitations: Hypothetical logistics case, not measured supply; no exact coordinates, dry-matter basis, composition, seasonal split, accessible fraction, or contract. Preserve disagreement between table sum and narrative scenario total.

description: Measured pilot press-juice yield and composition observations from two roadside-grass processing sessions in the Grassification project.
limitations: Pilot-specific process and material conditions; no explicit reuse license. Values are reference evidence only and do not establish GreenHub defaults or product specifications.

description: Supplemental environmental and feedstock field dataset from the Elshani et al. 2025 grass/clover biorefinery study.
limitations: Study-specific field observations; preserve original units, site and treatment context. Not a GreenHub runtime input.

description: Experimental design metadata accompanying the Elshani et al. 2025 field dataset.
limitations: Study-specific experimental design metadata; not a GreenHub runtime input.

description: Selected GR3 Belgian grass supply, seasonal handling, pretreatment and biogas case records
limitations: Historical report; data basis varies by record and several process/financial values are scenario estimates; not Dutch GreenHub inputs.

description: Published Polish municipality-level roadside-biomass supply scenarios and energy-crop comparison values.
limitations: External comparator only; Polish values are not Dutch roadside supply or runtime feedstock inputs.

description: Published Polish collection-capacity scenarios for roadside biomass under stated machinery assumptions.
limitations: External comparator only; capacity assumptions are study-specific and not GreenHub harvest or logistics defaults.

description: GR4SS project permit, design-capacity and target-production statements transcribed as separate evidence types.
limitations: Project and permit claims are not measured throughput or validated process performance; reference only.

description: HDSR projected mowing-material feed and biogas quantities for a proposed Newgein digestion project.
limitations: Planning projections only; no measured gas yield, wet/dry basis, procurement evidence or runtime connection.

description: Mixed-source roadside-grass composition and physical-property evidence; includes direct Smit et al. Table 1 comparator observations and explicit missing fields.
integration_readiness: reference_only; D1 audit gate remains blocked
limitations: Multiple feedstock studies and analytical bases; Smit values are comparator-only and do not replace GreenHub feed measurements or defaults.

description: One reported roadside-grass delivery observation for Ravels, including load count, approximate mass per load, equipment and interim storage conditions.
limitations: One report-specific collection observation, not annual supply or representative yield; report source and exact measurement basis remain limited.

description: GR3 Table 36 2015 Flemish grassland/road-verge inventory estimates plus separate Natuurpunt footnote update
limitations: Historical mixed grassland/verge estimate; 27% DM used for fresh mass; not a GreenHub Dutch collection contract.
